## Context / Problem

Live completion-gate captures show agentic runs wasting 40-70% of their request budget on DUPLICATE tool calls: one run repeated an identical search_files call 144x, another looped 62x on an honest "(no matches)" result. The shipped windowed distinct-ratio actuator (agent_call.py) correctly ABORTS pathological runs, but abortion is the backstop — nothing today prevents the waste before the trip point, and every duplicate re-executes the tool and re-pays the round-trip. Research across agent harnesses (OpenHands StuckDetector, smolagents max_steps) found detect-and-terminate everywhere but no harness that memoizes the duplicate and steers the model back on course — graduated nudge-then-abort is the recommended pattern.

## Approach

Add a memoize+nudge toolset wrapper at the shared agent-call seam (src/rebar/llm/agent_call.py), the module that already arms every tool-bearing Agent call: wrapper order runaway guard OUTERMOST -> memo -> steering (guard :68, steering :45; the guard's call_tool observes the signature before the memo short-circuits, so the actuator's window math is unchanged).

- Key: the EXISTING usage_log tool-call signature (identical normalization to the actuator — same signature means same dedup semantics).
- Behavior: first repeat of a signature returns the cached result plus a static templated nudge line; further repeats return the cached result plus a stronger static nudge; the distinct-ratio actuator remains the abort backstop. Static text only — a templated nudge keeps message content byte-stable for provider prompt caching.
- Non-memoization predicate (keyed on how the allowlisted tools ACTUALLY signal, pai_tools.py): these tools NEVER raise into the agent loop — they return strings. An ERROR result is one whose text begins with the "Error:" prefix (read_file/list_directory/search_files/show_ticket all return f"Error: {exc}" on ValueError/OSError). Error results are NOT memoized and NOT nudged: the identical call re-executes on retry, because a transient/again-different outcome is possible. By contrast the deterministic "sentinel-empty" results — "(no matches)" (search_files), "(empty)" (list_directory), "(empty range)" (read_file) — are HONEST, stable answers and ARE memoized+nudged: memoizing "(no matches)" is precisely the 62x-loop waste this ticket eliminates. (The "UNRESOLVED" resolve_symbol sentinel is moot here — resolve_symbol is not in the allowlist below.)
- Read-only allowlist: only read_file, search_files, list_directory, and show_ticket are memoized (all four exist in the verifier toolset, pai_tools.py:243); write or non-deterministic tools — including the banked-verification sibling's record_criterion_verdict — are exempt.
- No manifest / in-context awareness in THIS ticket: the FULL/skeleton "already in context" nudge depends on the pre-loading sibling's manifest, whose shape, marker vocabulary, and accessor are not yet defined and ship AFTER this change. This ticket therefore adds NO manifest coupling: every allowlisted read_file executes normally on first sight and returns the real content; duplicates get memoization plus the generic repeat nudge only. The manifest-aware FULL-branch nudge is deferred to the pre-loading ticket, which will layer it on this seam.

## Scope

- src/rebar/llm/agent_call.py — the memo wrapper + wrapper-order wiring (guard -> memo -> steering).
- tests/unit/test_agent_call_memo_nudge.py — new: memo semantics, wrapper order, allowlist, error passthrough (Error:-prefixed strings re-execute), sentinel-empty memoization ("(no matches)" cached), nudge escalation.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A duplicate allowlisted call returns the cached result without re-executing the tool; the wrapped tool function runs exactly once for N identical calls (unit test with a counting stub).
- [ ] Nudge escalation: first repeat carries the level-1 static nudge, subsequent repeats the level-2 text; both byte-stable across runs (unit test).
- [ ] The runaway guard still observes memoized duplicates: the distinct-ratio window sees every duplicate signature, and a synthetic loop still trips the actuator at the same call index with the memo active (unit test against the existing guard tests' fixtures).
- [ ] Error results are not memoized: an allowlisted call whose return begins with "Error:" re-executes on the next identical call (counting stub returning an "Error:"-prefixed string, then a success), and carries no nudge (unit test).
- [ ] Deterministic sentinel-empty results ARE memoized: a search_files-style stub returning "(no matches)" runs exactly once for N identical calls and the duplicate carries the repeat nudge (unit test) — the core waste case.
- [ ] Only allowlisted read-only tools are memoized; record_criterion_verdict and any non-allowlisted tool always execute (unit test).
- [ ] Live Bedrock capture recorded on this ticket: a run demonstrating either a nudge-broken loop (duplicate signature followed by a different next call) or a nudge->actuator escalation, with usage-log figures, backed by a durable in-repo artifact under docs/experiments/.
- [ ] make lint and make typecheck pass; the existing runaway-guard unit suite (tests/unit/test_agent_call_runaway_guard_c827.py) passes unchanged.

## Testing

Unit suite in tests/unit/test_agent_call_memo_nudge.py per the acceptance criteria (counting stubs, wrapper-order assertion, guard-interaction fixture reuse, Error:-prefix passthrough, "(no matches)" memoization). Run: python -m pytest tests/unit/test_agent_call_memo_nudge.py tests/unit/test_agent_call_runaway_guard_c827.py -q. Live Bedrock capture per the live AC recorded as a durable artifact under docs/experiments/ plus a ticket comment. make lint + make typecheck.
